title: Reflection on the use of GenAI
text:
In this assessment, I used Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT to help me understand the tasks and instructions more clearly.
I chose this tool because it provides simple explanations and step-by-step guidance, which was useful when working with unfamiliar tools like Quarto. It helped me organise my content and complete the assessment more efficiently.
Overall, GenAI was beneficial in reducing confusion and improving my learning experience. In the future, I believe such tools can continue to support my studies by assisting with learning and problem-solving, while still requiring my own understanding and effort.

title: Data Visualization
text:
The visualization below shows a breakdown of personal monthly spending across different budget categories.



This chart visualizes how personal monthly expenses are allocated across categories such as housing, food, transportation, savings, entertainment, and miscellaneous spending.



From the chart, housing takes up the largest portion of the budget at 30%. Food and savings each account for 20%, while transportation makes up 15%. Entertainment and miscellaneous expenses represent smaller portions of the overall spending.



A pie (donut) chart was used because it effectively shows how each category contributes to the total budget, making it easy to compare proportions at a glance.

title: Final Year Project
text:
Before entering SIT, I studied Accountancy and Finance at Temasek Polytechnic. As part of my learning experience, I worked on a project related to personal finance tracking and budget analysis.
The project focused on recording daily expenses, categorising spending such as food, transport, and entertainment, and analysing spending patterns over time. The goal was to improve financial awareness and support better budgeting decisions.
Through this project, I gained a better understanding of how financial data can be organised and analysed to support decision-making. This experience also helped prepare me for learning new digital and analytical tools at SIT.

title: Hobbies
text:
In my free time, I enjoy engaging in activities that help me relax and maintain a healthy balance between my studies and personal life.
One of my hobbies is playing video games, which helps me unwind and improves my problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. I also enjoy watching movies and television shows as a way to relax and explore different stories and perspectives.
In addition, I enjoy travelling and exploring new places whenever I have the opportunity. Travelling allows me to experience different cultures, environments, and ways of life, which helps broaden my perspective beyond academics.
These hobbies help me manage stress, stay motivated, and maintain a healthy lifestyle during my academic journey.

title: Calson See Jia Jun
text:
I am a Year 1 Fintech student at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT).
My journey is a bit unique—I graduated from Accountancy and Finance at Temasek Polytechnic. While I spent years mastering the world of balance sheets and financial markets, I had zero coding or tech knowledge before entering SIT.
I decided to pivot into Fintech because I’m fascinated by how technology is disrupting traditional finance. I am currently “learning to code” from scratch and loving the challenge of bridging the gap between finance and technology!
